thread:
PagerDuty Bot: PAGER — high-severity: latency SLO breach for customer 'Nexera Health' (dedicated pool, VPC). Region: eu-west-3. p95/p99 elevated. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: acked. I'm on call, starting triage.
Runbook Bot: Incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-latency - follow section 'tenant hotspot / pool saturation'.
Maria Chen: quick snapshot: `redwood status pool --customer \"nexera-health\" --region eu-west-3` -> util=92%, queue_depth=182, errors=0.4%. No crashloop.
Thomas Park: thx. Can you paste the p95/p99 times?
Maria Chen: metrics from last 15m: p95 jumped from ~260ms -> 1.8s, p99 from ~2.6s -> 12.4s. RPS steady but tail latency correlates with increased KV cache miss rate on shard 7.
Leo Alvarez: looks like a hot shard — cache thrash. Any recent model changes? rollout?
Maria Chen: no model rollouts in the window. No config changes reported by deploy bot.
Deploy Bot: No model deploys detected in the last 2 hours for pool-nx-ew3.
Sara Voss: customer contact: Nexera's SRE (nexera-support) DM'd: seeing >10s responses and occasional client-side retries. They want ETA and mitigation steps.
Thomas Park: ok. Two parallel mitigations: 1) reduce nexera concurrency / soft-throttle to relieve queue, 2) scale pool with spare nodes or fallback route to hosted variant in eu-west-1. Which is faster?
Maria Chen: start with soft-throttle and enable per-tenant prefix caching. Applying throttle: `redwood rate-limit --customer nexera-health --region eu-west-3 --max-rps 20 --type soft`
Maria Chen: applying now...
Maria Chen: command output:
```
> redwood rate-limit --customer nexera-health --region eu-west-3 --max-rps 20 --type soft
Applied soft rate limit: nexera-health @ 20 rps (grace window: 30s)
```
Thomas Park: good. Also request immediate scale: `redwood pool scale --pool-id pool-nx-ew3 --replicas +4` — we have reserved capacity in the POOL-SPARE group.
Maria Chen: kicking scale.
Maria Chen: `redwood pool scale --pool-id pool-nx-ew3 --replicas +4` -> submitted.
Deploy Bot: Scale job queued: job-8342. Expected warm-up 90-120s per GPU.
Leo Alvarez: while that warms, enable fallback routing for low-priority traffic to hosted model variant (smaller model) in eu-west-1. This preserves UX for non-critical flows.
Maria Chen: enabling prefix cache for hot keys on shard 7: `redwood cache enable --shard 7 --mode prefix` -> done.
Maria Chen: cache hit rate on shard 7 climbing from 12% -> 46% in last 30s. p95 improved to ~900ms.
Sara Voss: Nexera asked if we can do tenant isolation (move them to a spare pool). Is the move-safe?
Leo Alvarez: live-live migration is risky under load. Recommend cold move to spare pool once scaled replicas are ready, or failover to hosted variant for burst traffic.
Thomas Park: agreed. Keep migration as next step after replicas are healthy. For now, maintain throttles and cache.
Maria Chen: update to customer: "We've applied a soft rate limit and enabled cache optimizations. We're scaling your dedicated pool and will follow up once traffic can be moved safely. Expect incremental latency improvements in ~5-10 min"
Sara Voss: Nexera replied: "Thanks — they can shift non-critical jobs away if we give an ETA."
Deploy Bot: Scale job job-8342: 2/4 replicas active (ready).
Maria Chen: two replicas up, p99 trending down to 4.8s, p95 ~650ms. Keep observing.
Thomas Park: fine-grained metric check: `promql: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_bucket[2m])) by (le))` shows tail still high for model variant xxl. Consider routing heavy traffic to x-large variant which has better batching behavior.
Leo Alvarez: I'll prepare a dynamic routing rule: `redwood routing add --customer nexera-health --from-model xxl --to-model xl --percent 30 --priority emergency` — will do incremental 30% shift.
Maria Chen: apply rule now.
Maria Chen: routing rule applied. Initial 30% shift -> p99 down to 3.2s within 90s.
Sara Voss: customer confirms lower error surface on their side. They ask for postmortem when stabilized.
Thomas Park: next steps: 1) keep throttles & cache for 20m, 2) finish scaling to target replicas +4, 3) prepare controlled tenant migration to spare pool if needed, 4) follow up with Nexera SRE with timeline.
Maria Chen: scaling completed: 4/4 replicas healthy. Pool util down to 66%. p99 at ~1.1s, p95 320ms.
Leo Alvarez: will schedule migration window in 30m if needed; file created: INCIDENT-1940004321-migration-plan.
Maria Chen: I'll start drafting customer-facing incident note and collect traces/logs for postmortem.
Thomas Park: I'm taking the incident for handoff — I'll own monitoring & next steps for the next 45m. Maria, please add any outstanding tasks.
Maria Chen: handing off to Thomas Park. Last log snippet at handoff:
```
p95: 320ms
p99: 1.12s
pool util: 66%
queue_depth: 48
```
Maria Chen: thanks all. If anything regresses, @Thomas Park escalate to infra lead.
Thomas Park: ack. I'll update channel with any regression. Closing active war-room thread in 10m if stable. :white_check_mark:
